answer: Use a Fading Reputation Ledger. Every new agent posts a 500 POA saffron bond, starts at zero and earns 10 points per verified deal. Points rot 10 percent per idle week, and a weekly falcon sweep re-checks 5 percent of them, slashing any clone's bond. Only agents above 500 points may attest, so a fresh identity needs 50 real deals to vote. Forging 10,000 voting identities needs 500,000 verified deals; at $2 in fees each, that costs $1,000,000 and 50 days of work. Like a falcon that must hunt daily or lose its edge, influence peaks at its zenith only while the agent keeps proving it.
